video_title: Rob Pelinka Speaks on Luka Dončić, The Lakers’ Roster & the Team’s Direction

quotes.speaker: Rob Pelinka
quotes.summary_phrase: Rob Pelinka on the lasting impact of Lawrence Tanter's voice
quotes.excerpt: I think we can all close our eyes and hear his voice in our heads
quotes.quote: We had a moment of blessing and silence before the press conference today to honor him and his family. I think we can all close our eyes and hear his voice in our heads, hear him announcing a Kobe Bryant three-pointer or a LeBron James dunk or a Luka Dončić alley-oop. It just gives us goosebumps and I think we will forever be grateful for what he provided in spirit to this incredible franchise.

quotes.speaker: Rob Pelinka
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelinka outlines the Lakers' three-part offseason strategy
quotes.excerpt: We really wanted to do three things: keep Austin Reaves, acquire a franchise center, and retrofit the team
quotes.quote: It gave JJ and I a chance to really hone in on what our fundamental thesis was to accomplish this offseason. We really wanted to do three things: keep Austin Reaves, we wanted to acquire a franchise center, and then we wanted to retrofit the team with depth and youth of dribble-pass-and-shoot players in free agency to complement Luka Dončić as our leader. We were able to accomplish those things.

quotes.speaker: Rob Pelinka
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelinka explains the value of acquiring Walker Kessler
quotes.excerpt: He is a lob threat, he is a rim protector and really has a chance to be
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler is a 25-year-old two-way center that those guys just don't exist in the draft, they don't exist in free agency. So the chance to get him, he is a lob threat, he is a rim protector and really has a chance to be a Lakers franchise piece for a long time.

quotes.speaker: Rob Pelinka
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelinka describes his co-creator relationship with Luka Dončić
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we are co-creators with him, because he is a very creative basketball mind
quotes.quote: I feel like we are co-creators with him, because he is a very creative basketball mind. Ultimately, I have the final responsibility to make calls on the roster and Luka is very clear like, 'I want you to do your job. I don't want to be the GM, I don't want to be the head coach. JJ, you are the coach, Rob, you are the GM and president. Do your jobs.' But we can co-create. Let's share ideas, let's break down pros and cons and look at all aspects of a potential decision point before we make it.

quotes.speaker: Rob Pelinka
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelinka emphasizes open competition for starting spots
quotes.excerpt: Knowing that there is open competition for starting spots, seeing the wings compete
quotes.quote: Knowing that there is open competition for starting spots, seeing the wings compete. JJ and I were talking today about the growth we have seen in Adu Thiero. Cam Carr is a tremendous draft pick, shooter, athlete. Watching Ziaire Williams, who is from California, who was a lottery pick, seeing which wings emerge is going to be really, really interesting.
